title: Codewars 7kyu: Vowel Count
description: Return the number (count) of vowels in the given string `sentence`. We consider a, e, i, o, u as vowels for this Kata (but not y).
solution:
def get_count(sentence: str) -> int:
    return sum(1 for ch in sentence if ch in 'aeiou')
explanation: Iterates through characters checking membership in 'aeiou' in O(N) time.
